text: Life on the frontier weighed heavily on Dillon Boyd, whose frayed nerves finally snapped beneath the bleak discomfort of the barracks, sending him wandering in a psychotic haze. While Boyd lost himself to despair, the colony pressed on. Lidia "Stench" Schmitt, fully recovered from her wounds, tended to daily survival. She guided a pack animal to its pen, hauled salvaged steel and a substantial cache of silver to safety, and took a clumsy shot at a tortoise, missing entirely. Beyond the camp's perimeter, the local wildlife—including the persistent grizzly bear and grazing gazelles—remained an ever-present fixture of the untamed wilderness.
